summary: Use a Text Input for a single line of text, such as a search, with an icon that hints at what to type.

useWhen.text: A single line of text, such as a search, with an icon that hints at what to type.

from.quote: Use a Text Input for a single line of text, such as a search, with an icon that hints at what to type.

avoidWhen.text: The field needs a disabled or an error state: Text Input has neither.

from.quote: It has no disabled or error state.

avoidWhen.text: The field needs a visible label: Text Input has none.

from.quote: The field has no visible label, error, or disabled state

anatomy.holds: An icon that hints at what to type; a search icon by default. Always present.

from.quote: Hints at what to type; a search icon by default.

anatomy.holds: The placeholder, then what people type; one line.

from.quote: The placeholder, then what people type; one line.

anatomy.holds: Optional trailing content after the text, such as a filter icon.

from.quote: Optional content after the text, such as a filter icon.

anatomy.holds: The grey, fully rounded surface; a darker grey border shows focus.

from.quote: Grey rounded surface; a darker grey border shows focus.

placementAdvice.text: Text Input fills its container's width; set the width with the container.

from.quote: Text Input fills its container’s width and is 42 px tall, with 14 px of padding at each end and 18 px icons. The screen sets the width.

placementAdvice.text: Let the screen act on the text (for example filter a list) through onChangeText; Text Input only reports the text.

from.quote: The screen filters the list as people type; Text Input only reports the text.

configuration.text: Keep the search icon, or set leadingIconName to an icon that matches what people type. The leading icon cannot be removed.

from.quote: The leading icon is always there: keep the search icon or pick one that matches what people type.

configuration.text: Do not keep the search icon on a field that is not a search, such as an amount.

from.quote: A search icon on an amount field misleads.

configuration.text: Use trailing for a cue at the end of the field, such as a filter icon. It is empty unless you add content.

from.quote: The end slot is empty unless you add content.

configuration.text: Give a trailing Icon its own modes: without them it is gold; AppearanceBrand Neutral gives the grey the guide uses.

from.quote: A custom trailing `Icon` defaults to gold. `AppearanceBrand: Neutral` gives the grey `rgb(84,89,97)` used in the guide.

configuration.text: Do not pass an array to placeholder to rotate the prompt: the changing text distracts, and screen readers hear only the first prompt.

from.quote: Changing text distracts, and screen readers hear only the first prompt.

rules.text: A short prompt, the right icon, and room to type.

from.quote: A short prompt, the right icon, and room to type.

rules.text: Write a short placeholder that names what to type, such as “Search transactions”.

from.quote: Write a short placeholder that names what to type, such as “Search transactions”.

rules.text: Keep instructions out of the placeholder: it disappears as soon as people start typing.

from.quote: Keep instructions out of it: it disappears as soon as people start typing.

bad: Enter the 12-digit number exactly as printed on your card

states.when: No value: the field shows its placeholder.

from.quote: Empty, the field shows its placeholder.

states.when: While focused: a darker grey border appears and the placeholder clears.

from.quote: Focused, a darker grey border appears and the placeholder clears.

states.when: With a value: the field shows the text.

from.quote: Filled, it shows the text.

accessibility.text: Set accessibilityLabel when the placeholder does not say what the field is for; otherwise, on the web, the placeholder names the field.

from.quote: Set an accessibility label when the placeholder does not say what the field is for.

accessibility.text: Keep slot icons decorative and put no focusable controls inside leading or trailing.

from.quote: They ask for `accessibilityLabel` when the placeholder is empty or not descriptive, decorative slot icons, and no focusable controls inside the slots.

doDont.why: It is cut off and disappears as people type.

from.quote: Prompt with what to type

doDont.do: Match the icon to the task
doDont.why: A search icon on an amount field misleads.

from.quote: Match the icon to the task

doDont.why: Changing text distracts, and screen readers hear only the first prompt.

from.quote: Keep one fixed prompt

examples.purpose: A search field whose text the screen uses to filter a list.

from.quote: The screen filters the list as people type; Text Input only reports the text.

examples.purpose: An amount field with a matching leading icon.

from.quote: The rupee icon says an amount goes here.

examples.purpose: A search field with a filter cue in the end slot; the Icon gets its own modes.
examples.jsx:
<TextInput
  placeholder="Search funds"
  modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light' }}
  trailing={<Icon iconName="ic_filter" size={18} modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light', AppearanceBrand: 'Neutral' }} />}
/>

from.quote: A cue at the end, such as filters.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The placeholder text disappears on focus. Without accessibilityLabel, the field keeps the placeholder as its accessible name; a rotating placeholder names it after its first item. Declared: Placeholder when empty. A string is static; a string array (2+) cycles with a vertical slide (2000ms dwell, 500ms ease-out), using the same placeholder color/typography as the native placeholder. Default "", from the component source.

props.name: leadingIconName
props.description: The leading slot is always filled, by leading or by an Icon from leadingIconName; it cannot be hidden. Declared: Default "ic_search", from the component source.

props.name: trailing
props.description: A custom trailing Icon defaults to gold; AppearanceBrand Neutral gives grey.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Names the input and wins over the placeholder; without it the placeholder names the field and keeps that name while focused.

props.name: ...Omit<RNTextInputProps, "style" | "onBlur" | "onFocus" | "value" | "placeholder" | "onChangeText">
props.description: Inherited React Native props the component also accepts. They are not part of the design contract and no guide documents them.

props.name: TextInput.Search
props.description: The same field with a fixed ic_search leading icon. Declared: A static sub-component of TextInput. Its own props: placeholder, value, onChangeText, leading, modes, style, inputStyle, accessibilityLabel, accessibilityHint, onFocus, onBlur.

modes.name: Color Mode
modes.description: A token collection TextInput reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: InputState
modes.description: The component sets Active itself for its focus border (rgb(181,181,181)); the guide does not set it. Declared: A token collection TextInput reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

gaps.text: No visible label, error state or disabled state.
editable={false} makes the field read-only with no visual change, so it cannot stand in for a disabled state.
The field renders 42 px tall; Figma's is 44 px (open, lower priority, in #183).
